capabilities: Insert today's places at the cursor
Insert stops for a chosen date
Sync daily stops into daily notes
Connect to a Timeline account over OAuth
extras: Requires a paid Timeline Pro subscription; OAuth sign-in stays in Obsidian secure storage and never enters the vault; plugin has read-only access and sends no telemetry; no offline or file-import mode; Obsidian versions before 1.13 get plugin version 1.0.3.
problem: Obsidian has no way to bring the place and stop history recorded by the Timeline iPhone app into notes or daily notes.

relations.evidence: The plugin reads your shared Timeline Pro history over the network.
or from Periodic Notes when that manages your daily notes

summary: Plugin that inserts places recorded by the Timeline iPhone app into notes, or syncs each day's stops to daily notes.
